modification_description: The agent accepts the core synthesis (preserve intellectual rigor, revise delivery with safeguards) but adds three concrete requirements: (1) an evidence-based, student-centered investigation of specific incidents rather than unilateral management of discomfort; (2) an immediate behavioral adjustment if harassment is credibly established, prioritizing student safety over pedagogical intent; and (3) a clear structured process with institutional follow-through (teaching center consultation, mediation, or departmental guidance) rather than relying solely on John's personal judgment.
